why_ai: AI workloads increase demand for databases, and customers stake their data on a trusted engine.
why_clarity: Latency and correctness are measurable, but reading engine diagnostics remains specialist judgment.
why_digital: Code and data in, software and managed services out, sold remotely worldwide.

why_ai: AI raises analytical data volumes, and lock-in and openness keep platform choice a strategic bet.
why_clarity: Query cost and concurrency are metered directly, though layout optimisation needs expertise.
why_digital: Data and queries in, cloud compute and results out, bought online by data teams.

why_ai: Parameter tuning is a well-posed optimisation that AI-native software replaces outright.
why_clarity: A tuned configuration is checked instantly against observed workload performance.
why_digital: Workload metrics in, configuration settings out, all in software.

why_ai: Incident diagnosis is novel and high-stakes, but automated state capture removes most reconstruction work.
why_clarity: Engineers reconstruct transient incidents from logs and memory, each in their own way.
why_digital: Logs, metrics and tickets in, diagnoses out, handled remotely.

why_ai: A cross-fleet failure corpus is hard to replicate, but recognising the patterns is mechanical.
why_clarity: The same anti-patterns recur across thousands of systems and are mechanically recognisable.
why_digital: Fleet telemetry in, automated warnings out, entirely in software.

why_ai: Engines already expose every leading indicator; AI-native monitoring will read them instead of specialists.
why_clarity: Degradation paths are known and recurring, but a warning's correctness shows weeks later.
why_digital: Engine metrics and statistics in, alerts and diagnoses out, all on screens.

why_ai: Customers keep paying a vendor to run their databases; AI increases the workloads to run.
why_clarity: Uptime, failover and latency are contractual SLAs checked continuously.
why_digital: Managed cloud service provisioned, operated and bought entirely online.

why_ai: Live migrations are high-stakes, but their analysis and procedure are formalisable for automation.
why_clarity: Success is clear and immediate, but each significant migration is planned as a bespoke event.
why_digital: Schemas and data distributions in, migration plans and changes executed in software.

why_ai: Operating self-managed databases is unlicensed ops work that packaged automation will absorb.
why_clarity: Availability and performance are measurable, though each estate's configuration differs.
why_digital: Databases on data-centre hardware are operated through terminals, sold through enterprise channels.

why_ai: Predicting query behaviour from static analysis and production statistics is an automatable software task.
why_clarity: Every query written gets the same check, verifiable against production plans and timings.
why_digital: Query code and statistics in, predictions out inside developer tools.

why_ai: Request-path databases stay essential infrastructure, and AI applications add workload.
why_clarity: Tail latency and availability are exact metrics observed instantly in production.
why_digital: Application traffic in, database service out, bought and run entirely online.
